design_philosophy: A high-energy, raw, and vibrant 'Urban Canvas' look. Deep black backgrounds with cream text, punctuated by electric blue, hot pink, and warm orange graffiti splashes. Layouts are asymmetrical, mimicking a wall filled with wheatpaste posters, stickers, and spray paint. Elements are rotated, heavily textured, and unapologetically loud.

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) to allow textures and asymmetric rotations to breathe without overlapping text incorrectly.
layout.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' grid. Mix wide spans and tall spans. Overlap grid items visually by using negative margins or translate transforms. Never center everything perfectly.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E63EBD] text-black font-['Bungee'] uppercase px-8 py-4 border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#3DB8F2] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#3DB8F2] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#3DB8F2] text-black font-['Bungee'] uppercase px-8 py-4 border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#F26B2E] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#F26B2E] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] transition-all

cards.menu_item: bg-[#121212] border-2 border-[#2A2A2A] p-6 relative group hover:border-[#3DB8F2] transition-colors. Images inside should have a slight rotation (e.g., rotate-[-1deg]) and a polaroid-like white/cream frame.
cards.review_card: bg-[#E8D2A4] text-black p-8 relative rotate-[1deg] shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#E63EBD]

inputs.form_field: bg-transparent border-b-4 border-[#2A2A2A] focus:border-[#E63EBD] text-[#E8D2A4] font-['Bricolage_Grotesque'] py-3 px-2 outline-none transition-colors
inputs.label: font-['Bungee'] text-sm text-[#3DB8F2] uppercase tracking-wider

decorations.tape: absolute w-24 h-6 bg-[#E8D2A4]/50 backdrop-blur-sm rotate-[-15deg] top-[-10px] left-[-10px] z-10

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#050505]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b-2 border-[#E63EBD]
header.logo_treatment: Use the provided logo prominently. Height: 80px.

hero.style: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center items-center relative overflow-hidden bg-[#050505]
hero.visuals: Large logo centered, massive typography 'FRESH, HOT & LOADED'. Use a splatter SVG or CSS radial gradients in pink/blue blurred behind the text to mimic spray paint.
hero.animations: Subtle float animation on the logo.

marquee.style: bg-[#E8D2A4] py-4 border-y-4 border-black overflow-hidden flex whitespace-nowrap
marquee.content: 🔥 FRESH 🔥 HOT 🔥 LOADED 🔥 HUNGARIAN STREET FOOD 🔥 DAVENTRY 🔥

menu.layout: Grid of menu categories (Spuds, Fries, Crepes, Hungarian). Each category acts as a 'zone' with its own neon accent color (e.g., Spuds = Orange, Fries = Pink, Crepes = Blue).
menu.items: Use placeholder items but make them sound delicious. Include prices in a marker font.

about.layout: Two columns. Left: overlapping photos of the truck/festival with 'tape' edges. Right: Text about the Daventry-based story, styled as a wheatpaste poster.

reviews.layout: Horizontal scrolling or staggered masonry of bright cream-colored cards on the dark background. Use real review quotes provided.

booking_form.layout: Centred form in a heavy bordered container. Graffiti drips hanging off the bottom of the container.

footer.typography: Huge 'THE HUNGRY TRAILER' faded in the background, standard contact links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-fast-marquee for the moving text separator.
Implement Lucide React icons for the menu and contact sections (e.g., Flame, MapPin, Phone).
Add a fixed noise overlay (`.noise-overlay`) to give the entire app a gritty texture.
Strictly follow the typography scales. Do not use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. Bungee for primary headings, Bricolage Grotesque for body, Permanent Marker for annotations/accents.
All buttons must use the harsh, non-blurred drop shadow specified to maintain the brutalist/street art aesthetic.
Ensure the booking form uses Shadcn components but strip away the default subtle borders and radiuses, replacing them with thick lines and zero radius.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, form inputs, and major navigation links for testing.
